description: This file defines the FrameMapBuilder class, which constructs a FrameMap by managing lookup tables for frame and entry indices, including methods for setting frames, finalizing arrays, and building the FrameMap object.

classes.name: FrameMapBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing FrameMap objects, managing internal lookup tables for frame and entry indices, with methods to set frames, finalize arrays, and produce a FrameMap.

methods.name: setFrames
methods.description: Sets the start and end frames for a given entry range, updating internal lookup tables accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Finalizes the lookup tables and constructs a FrameMap object.

methods.name: setStartArrayValue
methods.description: Helper method to set the minimum value in an array at a specific index.

methods.name: setEndArrayValue
methods.description: Helper method to set the maximum value in an array at a specific index.

methods.name: finalizeStartArray
methods.description: Fills undefined entries in a start array with the next valid start value.

methods.name: finalizeEndArray
methods.description: Fills undefined entries in an end array with the previous valid end value.

methods.name: checkIsNotFinalized
methods.description: Ensures the FrameMapBuilder has not been finalized before allowing modifications.
